decision: A v3 validator fixture must use valid archive_pointer objects and a matching archive_policy summary. Every snapshot file must contain snapshot_path equal to the index pointer. Preserve malformed first attempts unreferenced and append corrected copies instead of overwriting them.

failures.root_cause: The synthetic v3 fixture lacked the newly required archive_policy object and did not use archive pointers for all three archive arrays.
The first 18:02 snapshot file omitted its required snapshot_path field, so the index pointer did not match the snapshot payload.

corrections.change: Updated v3 test fixture to create valid source/run/limitation archive shards, pointers and matching policy counts.
Created a corrected immutable snapshot copy with snapshot_path matching its new path; original malformed snapshot remains preserved unreferenced.
